statement: For disjoint source filled outers on the relaxed first sheet, their area cannot exceed its exact rectangle capacity. Total original filled area is fixed independently of transforms. Therefore actual selected short-sheet area must exceed total minus first capacity. Summing per-selected-part ceil(area*1000) is at least the true selected area in units, and flooring the necessary lower bound weakens it. Every remaining original has an exclusive sheet assignment: selector true means short sheet and false remains a mandatory first-sheet obligation. The objective is only a necessary relaxation ranking; its1e9 per-part weight exceeds the entire possible rounded area term, proving lexicographic count then area ordering.
